get.description: How the reading of a CV's files stands. A file uploaded with `purpose` `cv_source` is read once, in a queue the accounts take turns in, never while a draft is made: a CV draft (`ai.cv`, `cv_source` `linkedin` or `file`) whose files are still queued or being read is refused with `cv_reading` (409; `message_params.ahead` and `estimated_seconds` as here), to be made again once they are read. `ids` names the account's own files, at most ten; an id that is no live file of theirs is `file_unavailable` (404). A file with no read yet is queued. `ahead` is the most reads that finish before any of them is read, and `estimated_seconds` about how long until the last is read: 0 when none waits, null with no recent reads to tell it from. Asked every two seconds or so while waiting; more than 60 a minute is `rate_limited`.
